generations.prompt: Create TWO production key drawings for a restrained death animation of this exact lantern-keeper rabbit. Use the attached original as the absolute identity, proportions, painted fur, cream/teal patches, broad leaf ears, branching gold veins, and jewel design reference. Transparent alpha. Two equal square cells side by side, same scale and ground baseline, same left-facing three-quarter camera, generous margins. LEFT: midway collapse, eyes fully closed, front elbows buckle, chest lowers halfway, hindquarters and hind paw stay planted in exactly their original horizontal position. Head and chest retain their round volumes. Forepaws still support the chest. RIGHT: final quiet lifeless resting pose, elbows naturally folded, chest low, cheek and chin supported by folded forepaws, hindquarters anchored and rounded, no flattened body. Crucially BOTH broad leaf ears keep their original raised V silhouette relative to the skull. They follow the head with only a subtle 3–5 degree relaxation. No floppy ears, no ears covering the face, no leaf tips sweeping to the ground, no long drooping ribbon shapes. Gold drops remain attached and round. All four limbs accounted for with natural occlusion. Preserve the source body size and markings; do not grow, shrink, stretch, retexture or restyle it. No shadows, ground, effects, text, labels, grids or duplicate outlines. These are actual new animation key-pose cels, not a preview board.

PRODUCTION CUTOUT-RIG SOURCE ART for this exact lantern-keeper rabbit. Image 1 is the identity and NEUTRAL REST-POSE authority. Image 2 supplies the desired later bent-leg shapes, not a new design. Produce a clean TRANSPARENT 4x4 atlas containing EXACTLY 16 independent isolated parts, ONE part in each uniform square cell, ordered row-major as listed below. Keep each complete part at a consistent practical drawing scale, with at least 12% transparent padding on all sides. No assembled characters, no labels, numbers, grids, ground, cast shadows or extra objects. Preserve exact cream/teal fur palette, painted shading, outlines, original patterns and gold jewelry. Paint COMPLETE hidden contours behind overlaps and rounded joint ends so parts can articulate without holes. Draw the NEUTRAL upright anatomy for the bind pose; do not flatten or distort parts. List: row1 cell1 rounded pelvis/near hindquarter including its bent hind leg and grounded cream hind paw, WITHOUT torso/head/tail; cell2 front torso and back/belly between pelvis and neck, WITHOUT head/chest ruff/limbs/tail, complete hidden surfaces; cell3 complete round HEAD with OPEN dark green eyes, pink nose, cheek tufts and original small forehead/cheek gold jewels, WITHOUT either large leaf ear or chest ruff; cell4 exactly the SAME head, identical silhouette/position/size/texture, but eyes CLOSED. row2 cell1 complete layered cream CHEST RUFF, including its hidden upper edge; cell2 complete fluffy cream/teal TAIL; cell3 FAR FORELEG upper segment with rounded shoulder and elbow; cell4 FAR FORELEG lower segment including its complete cream paw, rounded elbow overlap. row3 cell1 NEAR FORELEG upper segment with rounded shoulder and elbow; cell2 NEAR FORELEG lower segment including its complete cream paw, rounded elbow overlap; cell3 FAR HIND LEG and paw, complete although mostly occluded; cell4 complete FAR/IMAGE-LEFT LEAF EAR in its original upright curved shape, with furry root, cream rim, mint green inner leaf, exact branching gold veins and narrow tip stem, but WITHOUT the hanging gold tip droplet. row4 cell1 complete NEAR/IMAGE-RIGHT LEAF EAR, original upright broad curved leaf shape, furry root, cream rim, mint green interior and original branching gold veins, narrow tip stem, WITHOUT hanging droplet; cell2 the FAR ear's original gold droplet only, round and complete; cell3 the NEAR ear's original gold droplet only, round and complete; cell4 exactly the same head as row1 cells3-4 with HALF-CLOSED eyes, identical face size/silhouette/textures. Do not duplicate the small head jewels onto ear roots. Every piece is actual usable source texture to reassemble into the attached original and animate into a restrained collapse.

Create SIX complete isolated source parts for the exact rabbit in the attached original, to rig its short thick CREAM-FURRED front legs. Transparent 3 columns x 2 rows atlas, one full part per cell, generous transparent padding, no clipping, no text or grid. Same painted fur and outline as reference. ALL front limb parts are ivory/cream with subtle sage shadow, matching its original visible forelegs; NO teal sleeves, green bands, armor, circles, new markings or jewelry. Top row: far foreleg UPPER segment from rounded shoulder to rounded elbow; far foreleg LOWER forearm segment from rounded elbow to wrist, WITHOUT paw; far front PAW alone in the original grounded angle, complete toes, soft rounded ankle overlap. Bottom row: near foreleg UPPER segment, rounded shoulder to rounded elbow; near foreleg LOWER forearm segment from elbow to wrist, WITHOUT paw; near front PAW alone, original grounded angle, complete toes and soft ankle overlap. Paint the entire hidden contours of each joint and limb, not cropped samples. Slight overlap padding at each joint, no sliced flat ends. Paws must be separate from forearms so that paws stay planted while elbows fold. These are actual animation texture attachments, not assembled animals, spritesheet motion frames, or a presentation.
